Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 17
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator prematurely issued “FINAL ANSWER: 67 Maclellan Rd” without verifying the required constraints. It relied on partial on-page JSON-LD (825 sqft) and did not ensure the property had at least 2 beds and 2 baths, nor that the sale fell within June 1, 2022–May 15, 2024. It also failed to complete the bathroom filter (2+) and apply/verify the date range, effectively selecting an address from noisy metadata after a system error rather than from filtered Zillow results.
